findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. 

The front screen door to the facility is observed to not completely close at the time of this inspection. The latch is jammed in the open position and does not allow for complete closing. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they are instructed to repair/replace prior to the next routine inspection. Provide for tight fitting outer openings of the facility in order to prevent the entrance of pests.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(3) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (3) Nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture.

The hand sink in the women’s bathroom is currently pulling away from the wall and exposing a gap that is not easily cleanable. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-seal prior to the next routine insepction. Ensure that all areas subject to moisture are maintained with smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.  

On arrival, no reporting agreements were available for observation. Multiple blank copies were given to the PIC and they were instructed to have each employee sign.

findings.title: Proper use of restriction and exclusion
findings.comment:
2-201.12: The PERSON IN CHARGE shall EXCLUDE or RESTRICT a FOOD EMPLOYEE from a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT in accordance with Law  symptoms/diagnosis.

An employee illness policy was not available during this inspection. Copies of the SCDPH paperwork were given to the facility during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

A vomit/diarrheal clean up policy was not available at this facility during this inspection. The policy given by SCDPH was given during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

The men’s bathroom is without paper towel during this inspection. Ensure paper towels are available at all hands sinks at all times. Follow up in 2 weeks for compliance.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

Food handler cards were not available for observation at the time of this inspection. The PIC indicated that they were off site currently being laminated. Maintain copies at the facility at all times.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
Facility serves pizzas without a pizza variance. CORRECTED— Completed request for pizza variance during inspection.
3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source. [P]

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed the facility to have raw fish and beef stored over an opened ice bag in the freezer. The raw meat product is for personal use by the owners. Ensure that any potential contaminants to the ice are stored below the ice. Raw meat moved during the inspection. 
750-160(a) Food shall be prepared with the least possible manual contact, using suitable utensils and using surfaces that have been cleaned, rinsed, and sanitized to prevent cross-contamination.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed the ice scoop to be stored with the handle in the ice. Ice scoop moved during the inspection. 
750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: See previous routine inspection.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment: Observed wastewater accumulation in  a bucket in the walk in cooler from the condenser fan leaking. It appears it had been at least a day or two since this had been emptied. Bucket was emptied during inspection. This must be emptied at least daily into the mop sink otherwise this needs to be plumbed to a drain.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: See previous routine inspection.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: See previous routine inspection.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: See previous routine inspection.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed fish in the upright freezer stored above bags of ice that had been being used for mixed drinks. Fish should not be in the establishment as this is outside of permit allowanced, however, if fish is for personal use and to be taken home, it should be stored correctly below the ice in the meantime. Remove fish from the facility.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed the inside of the upright freezer to be rusty. Seal or remove rust. 2) Observed the bar to be constructed of unsealed plywood and unsealed plywood where the new bar top will go. The top of the bar has been painted to seal. Seal the raw wood. 3) Observed behind the bar to have aluminum Nudo board on the walls with unfinished edges where different boards come together. Seal rough edges of the Nudo board so that it is smooth and easily cleanable. 4) Observed one of the fan covers in the walk in cooler to not be in place covering the fan. Replace fan cover.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
No mop sink is installed in the facility as it was taken out during the remodel and has not been re-installed. Provide a mop sink.
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the fan in the walk in cooler to be dripping water into a bucket. Provide proper plumbing to drain condensation run off from the walk in cooler fan.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
The drain pipe from the three compartment sink is observed extending down into the drain collar in the floor. A proper air gap should be in place to prevent cross connections. Provide an air gap at the drain pipe.
750-1060 There shall be no cross-connection between the safe-water supply and any unsafe or questionable water supply, or any source of pollution through which the safe water supply might become contaminated. Abate in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code. B

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
No hand washing sink is installed in the facility. Facility may ONLY serve bottled and canned beverages until a hand sink is installed. Install a hand sink and make sure it is stocked with warm water, soap and paper towels.
750-1120(a) Lavatories shall be at least the number required by law, shall be installed according to law and shall be located to permit convenient use by all employees in food preparation areas and utensil washing areas.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
1) Observed a half inch to one inch gap at the top of the screen door on the front of the building. 2) Observed the back door to be propped open at the beginning of the inspection. Door was closed during inspection to correct this part of the violation. Seal the front screen door if this is going to be used as the door so that the screen door is tight fitting to prevent pest entry.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the floors in the walk in cooler to be unsealed concrete. Seal floors in walk in cooler. 2) Observed the threshold leading into the men's restroom to be in disrepair. Repair floor going into men's restroom.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the walls in the women's restroom to have peeling wallpaper. Remove wallpaper and construct walls to be smooth and easily cleanable. 2) Observed the hand sinks in the restroom to be separating from the wall. re-caulk hand sinks to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed an old steam table and a roaster stored in the facility. These are not used in the facility and should be removed.
750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) inside beer cooler (buildup in bottom and on upper ledge where Bloody Mary mix is stored);
B) pizza oven (old food debris);   and
C) red table holding pizza oven.

Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text:
750.1120 - Soap and paper towels were not available at bar handsink. Soap and paper towels were placed at the handsink.

Maintain a supply of soap and paper towels at the bar handsink to allow for proper handwashing.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - A) Floor drain under bar 3 part sink was soiled with buildup. Clean the floor drain as needed and maintain clean.

B) Old cigarette butts were observed on the floor at the bar (left side of beer cooler & behind bottled beer reach-in cooler). Clean up cigarette butts (see general comments).

Floors shall be maintained clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text:
750.1210 & 1220 - A) Wall inside walkin cooler had soft/damaged wood. Repair the area of disrepair in the walkin cooler.

B) Mopsink was cracked/pulling apart on the left side. Repair or replace the mopsink.

C) Walls were soiled with buildup/splash around the mopsink, bar handsink, and beneath the 3 part sink. Clean the walls throughout as needed and maintain them clean.
Also, clean attached plumbing of fixtures.

Walls must be in good repair, constructed to facilitate easy cleaning, and maintained clean.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.citation_text:
750.1350 - Roasters, an unused microwave, condiments & food items (not necessary for low risk facility) were observed on-site. Remove all unnecessary items from the facility. (see general comments for details related to Horseshoe League)

Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.
